verdict.rationale: Make API tokens support 'relevant scopes enabled' for authentication, indicating some scoped credential capability, and MCP server access can be scoped to specific scenarios/tools rather than full account access. However there's no documentation of granular least-privilege scope definitions, no scope list, no per-agent credential issuance workflow, and no independent verification of enforcement. Missing for 10: a documented list of available API scopes, evidence of fine-grained least-privilege controls (e.g., read-only vs write, resource-level restrictions), and independent/hands-on confirmation that scoped tokens actually restrict agent access as claimed.
